pages.text: Upgraded Molecular Assembler, includes a pattern searcher.$(br)Modular design. Structures of different tiers are identical; only component tiers differ, so installation methods are universal.$(br)Look up the controller recipe in JEI, and you can see the structure diagram in the 'Structure Preview' tab.$(br)After adjusting to the appropriate size, click 'Project to World'.
$(6)Note: Maximum size is 12, and most blocks have orientation requirements.

pages.text1: Place patterns into the LD Pattern Bus. It supports Fluid Assembler patterns.
pages.text2: This block is used to connect AE cables, allowing EF to interface with AE just like a molecular assembler.
